# Shadowy

> Shadowy is a team workload transparency platform for service and accounting firms. Employees describe their work in about 30 seconds, AI turns it into structured entries, and managers see where the team's time goes, each client's true cost, and how workload is distributed. It is not time tracking and not employee surveillance.

Shadowy makes "invisible work" (Latvian: "neredzamais darbs") visible: helping colleagues, onboarding, coordination, repeated questions and out-of-role tasks. Employees log work in free text or by voice and the AI drafts a structured entry (category, client, duration) that the employee reviews and approves; managers then review entries and get analytics on hours by category and client, team workload, and which clients cost the most. Two core principles: it is not surveillance (no screen or keystroke tracking; nothing is saved without the employee's approval) and it does not rank people (per-person metrics support workload balancing, never scoring or leaderboards). Multi-tenant with role-scoped access, a fully Latvian interface with an English version, and data stored in the European Union. Based in Latvia, currently running a free 30-day pilot.
